verdict.rationale: Data export and the ability to leave is a fair question for a domain registrar and DNS provider, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented bulk data export, DNS zone-file export, or open-format download. The API, SDK registrar-lock toggle, and Terraform provider are developer building blocks rather than an export capability. Community transfer anecdotes concern moving into Namecheap or users leaving on their own, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
